name: Meimei Tenhou
source:
Meimei is a traveling medicines and drugs merchant, and a Chinese pharmaceutic. She came from the Far East on the board of a merchant ship. She has arrived here in order to investigate the unusual plants in the kingdom.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20020208134318/http://www.web-giga.com/win31/kingdam.htm]the official site[/url].]
